title: Airtable
metaDescription: Airtable works like a spreadsheet but gives you the power of a database to organize anything. Sign up for free.
h2: Creators and creatives use Airtable to organize their life’s work.
Build unlimited human-friendly databases for free.
h3: Airtable makes it easy to organize stuff, people, ideas and anything else you can imagine with your team.
ctas: Nichole Nadkarni@Cre8iveNC@airtable is a word I’m not allowed to use at dinner because I talk about it too much! Hahah!!!!
Nancy X.@nancychowmeinloooving @airtable. finally a good home for hiking / reading / movers lists and haven’t even scratched the surface
Peter Van Dijck ☁@petervandijckWow @airtable is just really good in the little UI interactions, where these things often fail. Really enjoying it.
Amandah Wood@amandahwood.@airtable is the app that’s been missing from my life.
Robert Lo Bue@roblobueCan’t believe how great @airtable is. I’m merging many different spreadsheets and contact books, in one place.
Judson Mitchell@judsonmitchellI’m really impressed with @airtable. It’s what spreasheets should have been in the first place.
Meg Lewis@darngoooodWe’ve been using @airtable to organize our home renovation projects and it’s been so perfect!
Stephanie Leishman@hatchstephDear @airtable, you are the coolest. Customizable databases with views/formulas... great iPhone app... ahhh this is the life.
Simon Eskildsen@SirupsenI spent so much time in @airtable this weekend I dreamt about it two nights in a row..
ashton kutcher@apluskI use this tool every day. http://venturebeat.com/201...
Brian Fink@thebrianfinkIf you are starting your #jobsearch, try @airtable to make it more effective #jobs #careers
Stephanie Engle@Soengle@airtable You serve a noble purpose. Just wanted to say that, and props to your designers for making spreadsheets *gasp* enjoyable.
Zee M Kane@ZeeAbsolutely in love with @airtable. Using it as a team task management app but it's so powerful (yet simple), can be used for many other uses
